_comment: Source of truth for mineable resource blocks. Run generate_resource_blocks.py to build the loot tables and block tags from this file, and to solve the tool speeds. Nothing it generates should be hand-edited.

hardness_families._comment: Every block a resource_block object may draw on, grouped by vanilla hardness. Mining time is ceil(hardness * 30 / speed), so tool speeds are solved per family from each resource type's stage_ticks. A family is only ever mined by one resource type's tool, so two families may share a hardness.

resource_types._comment: category names the folder this resource's block tags live under. stage_ticks is how long one break takes, and every break moves a tile on a stage.

_resource_blocks_comment: The blocks a biome's tiles of each resource type are built from, every one of which a tool can break. Breaking any of them sends a seed naming the resource type and the biome, and moves the tile it stood on a stage.
